newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen International '96 net 50 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen International '96 net 50 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen International Enterprise Co Ltd registered net profit of 49.77 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Wednesday.
Earnings per share were 0.324 yuan in 1996 and turnover hit 201.85 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
The company posted net profit of 35.39 million yuan for 1995 under international standards.
Based on Chinese standards, the firm's 1995 net profits were 40.83 million yuan, according to its 1995 annual report.
The firm has proposed a one-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 profits and another one-for-10 bonus issue based on capital surplus, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Thursday morning and resume in the afternoon, it said.
